name: The Lindwyrm's Test
source:
When a terrible dragon demands a bride, Freja is sent to the slaughter by her queen. No woman, noble blood or peasant born has returned alive, only swallowed up by the creature. But the queen has other plans this time. She tasks Freja with tricking and slaying the beast. Before she can defeat him, freja must first pass the beasts test… A listening test. Despite her terror and the task at hand, can Freja listen well and answer the beast's questions correctly? Or will she be swallowed whole like all those before her? 

[From [url=https://basket-cat.itch.io/the-lindwyrms-test]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
当一头可怕的恶龙索要新娘时，女王将芙蕾雅推上了死路。此前无论贵族千金还是农家村姑，没有一个女人能活着回来，全都葬身龙腹。但这一次，女王另有所图——她命芙蕾雅设法智取并诛杀这头恶兽。然而在击败恶龙之前，芙蕾雅必须先通过它的考验……一场“倾听测试”。面对内心的恐惧与肩负的刺杀使命，芙蕾雅能否用心倾听、准确答出恶兽的每一个问题？还是会重蹈前人的覆辙，被它一口吞入腹中？

[摘自[url=https://basket-cat.itch.io/the-lindwyrms-test]itch.io[/url]]
